en.title: Bina Mulya Samajik Suraksha Yojana
en.benefit: Free cover paid by the state: Rs 50,000 on natural death, up to Rs 2 lakh on accidental death or disability, and provident fund contribution.
en.how_to_apply: Apply on the BM-SSY portal or at a Regional Labour Office or Labour Welfare Facilitation Centre in your block or municipality.
